geography.method: Each commune (Paris, Lyon, Marseille: each arrondissement) is weighted by the share of its registered voters (inscrits) who voted in this district in the 1st round of the 2024 legislative election. Communes are converted to the INSEE COG 2026.

source.name: Ministère de l'Intérieur — Élections législatives 2024, résultats définitifs du 1er tour par bureau de vote

stateSpending.reason: The State does not publish its spending broken down by commune, district or department (budget execution is published by mission and programme at national level). The only sub-national State money in open data is what it transfers to local authorities — see localSpending.*.stateTransfers (DGF and other grants, OFGL) — which is a local receipt, not State spending in the territory. No approximation is made.
